sheets.notes: This 'COLD-FORMED STEEL WALL DESIGN (AISI)' sheet (Tedds 1.0.00, AISI S100-07 ASD) is a table look-up only: it prints wall type, s = 16 in, H = 12 ft, the 350S162-54 dimensions (Dw 3.5 in, Wf 1.625 in, Tm 0.054 in, Ll 0.5 in), Fy = 50 ksi, P = 1.76 kips, Pressure = 5 psf, Pallow = 2.44 kips from the SSMA table, P / Pallow = 0.721, and deflections. No gross/effective section properties (A, Ix, Sx, rx, ry, J, Cw, xo, ro, Ae, Sxe), no KxLx/KyLy/KtLt, no Fe/Fcre/λc/Fn/Pn/Pa, no Mn/Ma, web crippling, shear or interaction values are printed. 'Actual deflection' is not computed from the 5 psf load: it is printed as δ = H / 720 = 0.2 in (a fixed ratio) against δallow = H / 240 = 0.6 in, so the deflection check is a placeholder. AISI S100-07 is superseded (CBC 2022 references AISI S100-16). Drawing wall schedule calls the studs 'CFS 18 G.A. FY=33KSI' and '350S162-54 (2"X4", 18GA)', whereas -54 mil is 16 ga and the calc uses Fy = 50 ksi.

observations: Edition mismatch: drawings cite 2022 CRC/CALGreen (plus legacy 'UBC' and '2019 Green Code' notes) while calcs use AISC360-10 (beam) and AISC360-16 (column) in the same package, ACI318-14 and AISI S100-07; CBC 2022 adopts ACI 318-19, AISC 360-22/16 and AISI S100-16.

CFS stud sheet is an SSMA table look-up only: no section properties, unbraced lengths, Fe/Fcr/Pn/Pa, Mn/Ma, web crippling or interaction printed; deflection is a placeholder (δ = H / 720 = 0.2 in, not derived from the 5 psf lateral pressure).
CFS material mismatch: wall schedule says 'CFS 18 G.A. FY=33KSI' and details '350S162-54 (2"X4", 18GA)'; calc uses Fy = 50 ksi and Tm = 0.054 in (54 mil = 16 ga, not 18 ga).

Load path inconsistency: HSS column Pr = 34 kips (factored) but base plate Pu = 3.0 kips, pad footing F2 column loads FDz1 = 3.5 / FLz1 = 2.1 / FEz1 = 1.2 kips, and lintel reactions RA = RB = 2.7 kips.
W10x22 lintel modelled fixed-fixed (both supports rotationally restrained) with only dead UDL 0.4 + 0.022 kips/ft over 10 ft; live/roof/snow factors listed but no such loads applied.

Anchor bolts: base-plate anchor calc uses cast-in headed bolts at 8 in, separate ANCHOR BOLT sheet uses hooked bolts at 12 in; drawings show 3/4" J-bolt embedded 7" min while both calcs use hef = 6 in. ANCHOR BOLT sheet is truncated after ϕVcpg = 39.04 kips (no pryout PASS, no interaction).

F1 strip footing calc (Ly = 1.5 ft, h = 12 in, No.4 @ 8 in c/c bottom) vs schedule F1 18"W x 12"D with (3) #4 top and (3) #4 bottom long. & #4 @18" trans.; F2 calc 3 ft x 3 ft x 12 in with 4 No.4 bottom bars each way matches 36"X36"X12" tag but no F2 reinforcement scheduled.
Lap splice schedule on drawings is for f'c = 2500 PSI while all footing calcs use f'c = 4000 psi.
Column unbraced length 138 in (11.5 ft) vs CFS wall height H = 12 ft and 12' section dimension.
Calc report dated 04-25-2026 / Calc. by 4/25/2026 while drawings are issued 10/13/2025.
extractionNotes: Values copied verbatim from the text dump (no recalculation). Markdown escape backslashes in the dump were removed (e.g. 'Vw\_max' -> 'Vw_max', 'Fc\*' -> 'Fc*'). Keys are the printed Tedds symbols; where a symbol repeats on a sheet the key carries the printed heading context in [brackets] and '#n' for further repeats. 'labels' maps keys to the printed description. Inputs = plain printed values in input blocks; results = computed values (printed with a formula), ratios, and values printed in analysis/design blocks; results.checks = PASS/FAIL lines as printed.
